source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting results that contradict the hypothesis in a psychology research report

1. Start with the research records.
2.
completion:
Start with the findings.
3. Start with the prior knowledge about the phenomenon the research was investigating.
4. Start with the results themselves and ask: what would have been the most appropriate conclusions if they had been from observations of typical people in natural settings?.

* * *
The best way to reduce errors in research is to start with the basic elements or the first principles. 
The basic elements deal with the results of the research. 
They are the raw observations without any interpretation.
The results are records of the basics. 
The basics are the results of the observations of the study. 
The results are the basic records. 
All results are just records, recordings of the research.
